worldcombat.skill.furycutter.summary: Successive hits increase the number of strikes. Missing or using another move resets the buildup.
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.description: Each cut deals %1$s contact damage, so more cuts bite deeper.
Consecutive hits double the segment count: 1 cut, 2 cuts, then %1$s cuts - the segment count is the number of times damage is really settled.
The chain survives as long as you keep cutting within %1$s; a whiff or any other committed move clears it at once.
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.growth.0: From level %1$s each cut rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.growth.1: From level %1$s the cutting reach extends to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.use.0: Swing twice the number of cuts each pass
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.use.1: Keep hitting to build the chain deeper
worldcombat.skill.furycutter.use.2: Lose the chain to a whiff or another move
On (pressing): the chain window gains 30 ticks and the step grows, at +1 tick between cuts, +1 preparation, +2 recovery and +5 cooldown. Off (quick recovery): faster recovery and cooldown and denser cuts, at a shorter step and a chain that fades sooner.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of cutting. Larger values open the chain from further out.
On: while it carries the chain identity it prefers to keep cutting, extending the string. Off: it ranks the move as an ordinary mid-range flurry either way.
world_combat.move.furycutter.text.miss: Fury Cutter whiffed; the chain is gone
